title: FIRST kalıcı proje ve repo verisi
goal: Proje okuma/düzenlemeyi GitHubdan ayır; repo listesini backendde sakla ve kullanıcı yenilemesine bağla

assumptions: User explicitly replaces live provider proof after project creation with persisted publication snapshot.
Repository collection is imported once, refreshed only by explicit user action, empty snapshot is valid.
Additive schema migration required for persistent repository collection/previews/project link snapshots; normal deployment authorized.
Source/diff checks only, no tests/lint/typecheck/browser/local build.

constraints: Kullanıcı aksini söylemediyse accepted entegrasyon mantıksal commitlerle main branch'e push edilir; alt writerlar bağımsız push yapmaz ve force-push yasaktır.
Backend servisleri ve lokal Docker agent makinesinde başlatılmaz.

items.title: backend
items.objective: Persist project snapshots and repo collections/previews; DB-only project reads/edits/create with exact preview consent and safe refresh isolation.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Persist project snapshots and repo collections/previews; DB-only project reads/edits/create with exact preview consent and safe refresh isolation.

items.title: frontend
items.objective: Initial cached repo read and explicit refresh controls preserve drafts, display saved time and submit exact preview token; edits independent of GitHub binding.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Initial cached repo read and explicit refresh controls preserve drafts, display saved time and submit exact preview token; edits independent of GitHub binding.

items.title: GitHub bağlantı envanteri
items.objective: Document every remaining GitHub API, redirect and browser asset trigger from source.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Document every remaining GitHub API, redirect and browser asset trigger from source.

reasons: Read-only inventory with owned doc output

items.title: review
items.objective: Independent source review accepts snapshot privacy/consent, refresh concurrency, cleanup, frontend and additive schema.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Independent source review accepts snapshot privacy/consent, refresh concurrency, cleanup, frontend and additive schema.

items.title: verify
items.objective: Manager verifies DB-only project paths and all remaining GitHub connection inventory against source.
items.responsibility: Only explicitly owned files; no independent commit/push or execution checks.
acceptanceCriteria: Manager verifies DB-only project paths and all remaining GitHub connection inventory against source.
